description: This PHP source file defines the WorkShiftDao class, which manages database operations related to work shifts within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class provides methods to retrieve, save, update, and delete work shift data, as well as manage employee associations with work shifts.

classes.name: WorkShiftDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing WorkShift entities, including CRUD operations and employee associations within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkShift entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingWorkShiftIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing work shift IDs from a given list of IDs.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Fetches a list of work shifts based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for iterating through filtered work shifts.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Counts the total number of work shifts matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: saveWorkShift
methods.description: Saves a new WorkShift entity and associates employees to it within a transaction.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Creates EmployeeWorkShift records linking employees to a specific work shift.

methods.name: updateWorkShift
methods.description: Updates an existing WorkShift and adjusts employee associations accordingly.

methods.name: getEmployeeListByWorkShiftId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Employee entities associated with a particular work shift.

methods.name: deleteExistingEmployees
methods.description: Removes employee associations from a work shift.

methods.name: deleteWorkShifts
methods.description: Deletes work shift records by their IDs.
